correctness.rationale: The entrance event E_0 forces a uniform-on-surjections middle word on n-1 other coupons, independent of fresh future draws. Exact singleton-prefix falling factorial moments are (k)_r S(M-1-r,n-1-r)/S(M-1,n-1). The tilted zero-truncated Poisson occupancy law and lattice local estimate yield n^(-alpha r) at fixed r and k~t n^alpha. Replacement and multiple-occurrence expiry errors are O(n^(alpha-1)) for fixed 0<alpha<1, proving conditional Exp(1) survival. Stationary complete mass divided by new-entrance flux yields exact mean n S(M,n)/[(n-1)S(M-1,n-1)]. This complete calculation is independently corroborated by a prior October 26 full proof and a stronger November 2 Poisson-process proof. These are scientific coverage issues, not correctness defects.
